_doc: Targets of the pass line (bench/deps_bench.py, `make bench-passline`). Data only. repo + commit: fetched into $BENCH_CACHE (default ~/.cache/rivus-bench/), never into this tree; the code of a target is never run (git clone/checkout, `go mod download`, `dart pub get`). args: the flags of `rivus analyze` besides -lang and -C (none: the default flags). time_limit_s / mem_cap_gb: the pass line. decided: false = the line is printed as INFO (the limits are not decided yet). detect: the category whose finding count is compared on the pre-fix and the fixed commit (counts only).

smoke._doc: a small local tree (bench/go-curated), to check that the script works end to end; not a target
